institution: Department of AI & Data Science, RMK Engineering College
milestone: Phase 5 Step 5 — Root Cause Analysis Agent Implementation
verdict_justification: The ManuMind Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Agent has been fully implemented, integrated with the shared state architecture, and verified as a LangGraph StateGraph node function (root_cause_analysis_node). The agent ingests Anomaly Detection Agent assessments, sensor telemetry, and feature attributions; queries historical maintenance work orders via MCP tool handle_get_maintenance_history; queries manufacturing SOPs and technical manuals via RAG retrieval bridge handle_search_manuals while preserving [CIT-X] citations and neutralizing prompt injections; formulates multiple competing diagnostic hypotheses via the provider-independent ManuMindLLMClient protocol; and computes transparent evidence-corroboration support scores strictly bounded in [0.05, 0.95]. It enforces that same-source citations and same-observation sensors do NOT count as independent source types, caps synthetic evidence corroboration at 0.70, and discloses scores as corroboration indices rather than physical probabilities. Critical security and governance invariants are strictly maintained: CandidateRootCause cannot self-assert VERIFIED status, worker update validation strictly blocks modifications to human_approval, verification_decisions, or workflow_status, and no tickets or approval tokens can be minted. All 40 dedicated unit and integration tests in backend/tests/test_rca_agent.py pass (100%), and the complete 145-test Phase 5 regression suite passes with zero failures.
